{{Quote | quote = Sol-III, the third planet from the sun. A world of chaos and change, where old conventions are discarded and disasters run rampant. Human civilization struggles to survive in this new era of destruction and rebirth, facing uncharted challenges with unwavering determination. | speaker = [https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com/en/main#lore| ''Wuthering Waves Official Website''] | source = }} {{Location Infobox |type = World |image = Sol3 PostLamentAnthropocene 4K.png|Official Art 3.5 Map.png|Current Map (3.5) |map = Solaris-3 }} '''Solaris-3''', also known as '''Sol-III''' and '''Solaris''', is the third planet from the sun and the setting of ''[[Wuthering Waves]]''. In the ancient past the planet was ravaged by a series of global catastrophes known collectively as [[The Lament]]Strictly speaking, the Lament is an ongoing event in the present.. During one of these global Laments, the planet's axis and magnetic poles shifted to dramatically change the surface climate and ecology, and in the aftermath the [[Etheric Sea]] spread over the planet. This process also physically separated Solaris from the rest of the universe, killing civilisation's budding spaceflight capabilities in its cradle, and gave rise to the [[Waveworn Phenomenon|Waveworn Phenomena]], a series of anomalous occurrences resulting from the destabilization of natural laws. However, thanks to the Lament, humans have gained the ability to resonate and manipulate frequencies, giving rise to [[Resonator|Resonators]]. ==Nations== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center;" ! [[Spacetrek Collective]] |- |[[New Federation]] |Unknown, possibly [[Promeus]] |''Unknown'' |''Unknown'' |''Unknown'' |- |[[Ashinohara]]As of ''Starlights from Yesterdays'', Ashinohara has disappeared under mysterious circumstances. |''Unknown''The five [[Legacy Talismans]], each bequeathed by a Sentinel, suggests Ashinohara may have had five Sentinels. |Neo Honami |''Unknown'' |''Unknown'' |} ==History== Over the past 10,000 years, Solaris-3 has suffered five global Laments and over 350,000 regional Laments. The Tethys Institute, a facility in the [[Pre-Lament Civilization]], enacted a [[Resolution K626|plan]] to save humanity after the destruction of 80% of all structures and half the population in the first global Lament. Solaris' current nations appear to have been established in the last millennia, although the current state of the Roya Frostlands and their settlement by the Roya may have been established as early as the second global Lament. [[Rover]] likely first appeared in Solaris 10,000 years ago, just as the [[SkyArk Space Station]] was destroyed in the final moments of Solaris' envelopment by the Etheric Sea. It is possible that Rover, or other [[Homeland Civilization]] compatriots, were monitoring the planet before the onset of the Lament. ==Trivia== * Aside from its etymology, Solaris is likely a reference to [[wp:Solaris (novel)|Solaris]], a 1961 novel by Stanisław Lem which shares some features with the planet of Wuthering Waves. * Solaris-3 is named in a fashion similar to many classic scifi planets, using the star name (Solaris) plus a number representing the distance from said star. This differs from the naming scheme of real exoplanets such as [[wp:Proxima Centauri b|Proxima b]], where they receive lowercase letters in order of discovery. ** Coincidentially, under the same convention, real-life planet Earth would also be named "Sol III". * Sol, also known as [[Exostrider|Baldur]], is also the name of the [[Roya Tribe|Roya's]] god. ===Etymology=== * {{Lang|Solaris|la=sōlāris}} is translated as "solar," derived from the Latin for "sun". ==Gallery== File:Solaris-3 Map 1.0.jpg|1.0 Map - Huanglong File:Solaris-3 Map 1.1.jpg|1.1 Map - Huanglong updated with Mt.
